values.note: 2025 rates (the last the operator posted): small electric-only sites (13-15) $45 a night, large electric-only sites (1-12, 19-21) $50; tent sites $25. Not open in 2026.

values.note: Sites 1-26: 18 electric-only RV sites (1-15, 19-21), three camping cabins (16-18) and five tent sites (22-26), besides a cottage and the main house's lower floor.

note: On CO-133 (West Elk Loop) at mile marker 31, on the south side of McClure Pass about 3 mi above Paonia Reservoir, beside Muddy Creek. No cell service. Kayak rentals. --Claude
